description: Creates a new ERD — empty or from SQL/DBML text. With a {file} target it saves locally; with {server:true} it saves to the server (login required). Pass workspaceId to bind it to that workspace's naming standard from the start.

sql.description: CREATE TABLE SQL (mutually exclusive with dbml)

server.description: Save as a new server ERD

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from list_workspaces) whose standard the new ERD links to — its word list, naming rules and domains are pulled in immediately, so physical names follow the team standard. Requires login. Omit for a standalone ERD with an empty word list.

name: create_erd
